description: Find and inspect issues, epics, tasks, and other work items. Actions: list (groups return epics, projects return issues/tasks, filter by type/state/labels), get (by numeric ID or namespace+iid from URL path). Related: manage_work_item to create/update/delete.

after.description: Cursor for pagination (use endCursor from previous response) Required for 'list' action(s).

first.description: Number of items to return Required for 'list' action(s).

id.description: Work item ID to retrieve - use numeric ID from list results (e.g., '5953') Required for 'get' action(s).

iid.description: Internal ID from URL (e.g., '95' from /issues/95). Use with namespace parameter. Required for 'get' action(s).

namespace.description: Namespace path (group or project). Groups return epics, projects return issues/tasks.

simple.description: Return simplified structure with essential fields only. RECOMMENDED: Use default true for most cases. Required for 'list' action(s).

state.description: Filter by work item state. Defaults to OPEN items only. Use ["OPEN", "CLOSED"] for all items. Required for 'list' action(s).

types.description: Filter by work item types Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_work_items
